Every post here is a [Quarto](https://quarto.org) document. It can mix prose, Python, R and
diagrams, and the output you see is generated from the code you see.

## The pipeline

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Write .qmd] --> B[quarto render<br/>on my laptop]
  B --> C[(_freeze/<br/>cached results)]
  C --> D[git push]
  D --> E[GitHub Actions<br/>quarto render]
  E --> F[Netlify]
```

The trick is **freezing**. Code only runs on my machine. The results are saved in `_freeze/`
and committed, so the build server never needs Python or R installed.

## Python or R, same post format

::: {.panel-tabset}
## Python

```{.python}
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv("data.csv")
df.groupby("team").size()
```

## R

```{.r}
library(dplyr)
read.csv("data.csv") |> count(team)
```
:::

## Writing a new post

```{.bash}
python scripts/new_post.py data "My next analysis"
quarto preview
```

That's it. Thanks for reading!
